configs.description: The manager as Panduit ships WMPVHC45E, all four covers fitted.

configs.description: The same manager with its covers taken off, the finger columns and the channels open to lay a cable in. The covers come with the manager, so this is an illustration and not a device type.

gaps.note: the covers are "dual hinge" and open 110 degrees to the left or the right; no view draws a hinge, and each cover is drawn as one fitted plate that is either on or off.
gaps.wanted: a drawing or a close render of a cover's hinge

gaps.note: the drawing's Detail A gives the finger as 4.73 in [120.1] long with a 25.4 opening between two fingers; each finger is one loop across the width and is drawn as two 40 mm halves, one from each side, so that the eight oval holes lie clear of them, and as a solid block 19.05 high.
gaps.wanted: a section through a finger and the backbone

gaps.note: the sheet dimensions the eight holes' sizes (4 x 132.1, 4 x 68.6, all 55.9 wide) and not where they stand down the length; their places are read off the view to about 30 mm.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned elevation of the backbone

gaps.note: the maker's WMPVHC45E DXF (16 MB) and DWG were not read: the figures here come from the PDF drawing.
gaps.wanted: the DXF read for the finger and hole measurements
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - the material, colour, standards and what is in the box are the WMPVHC45E product page and the specification sheet (RKSP112); the temperatures are the customer drawing's.

bottom.note: estimated - the top view again: the two ends of the manager are alike.

capacity.note: datasheet - Panduit's Cable Capacity Calculator (V14) gives the WMPVHC45E's front and rear usable areas as 30.7 sq in each and, for its entered cable (0.185 in, 4.70 mm, Cat 6A 28 AWG) at the 30 per cent recommended fill, 342 front and 342 rear (570 each at the 50 per cent maximum). The specification sheet says each large finger opening accommodates up to 24 Category 6 cables.

chassis.note: drawing - 170 x 2108 x 357: the drawing's "6.7 [170]", "83.0 [2108]" and "14.1 [357]"; the specification sheet states the same (6.7 x 83.0 x 14.1 in, 45 RU), covers fitted.

color.note: estimated - "The manager is black" on the product page. Every image Panduit publishes of the part is a render; the covers are drawn a shade lighter than the backbone.

depth.note: drawing - drawn as a 166.1 front channel, a 24.8 backbone and a 166.1 rear channel: the plan dimensions "6.54 [166.1]" and the 357 overall, and Panduit's calculator gives equal front and rear areas (30.7 sq in).

front.note: drawing - the front with its two covers fitted: the covers, and under them the backbone with 45 fingers in three sections of 15 either side of the eight oval holes. The `duct` guide is the channel between the finger columns, run down the height, 132 across (the calculator's 30.7 sq in over the 150 mm fingers), ESTIMATED; the pitch is the rack unit and the gap the drawing's Detail A, 1.00 in [25.4].

guides.note: drawing - each duct is the channel between the two finger columns of its face, run down the height (`run: y`); the finger pitch is the 44.45 rack unit and the gap the 25.4 of Detail A.

left.note: estimated - no side view is drawn: the backbone, and the two finger zones along it, built from the plan view and the finger columns' extent.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S OWN DOCUMENTS. Panduit publishes the WMPVHC45E as a customer drawing (PDF 10225-25, two sheets; a 16 MB DXF and a DWG that were not read), the NetRunner Vertical Cable Managers specification sheet RKSP112, installation instructions, a product page and the Cable Capacity Calculator. The drawing's views are read at 110 and 220 dpi. THE FIGURES THE DRAWING DIMENSIONS ARE `drawing`; EVERYTHING READ OFF THE PICTURES (the oval holes' places, the finger's length and the split between the channels' fingers) IS ESTIMATED and said so in the part that carries it.

mount.note: drawing - `rack-side`, as the FS vertical ducts: the drawing (Panduit 10225-25) lists "4- MOUNTING BRACKETS" and "8- #12-24 X 1/2" SCREWS" and its rack outline stands beside the manager; the specification sheet (RKSP112) gives the pitch of the manager side-mounted to a 19 in rack (27.1 in) and the WMPVSMK, WMPVCBE and WMPVCMB mounting kits. It occupies no rack unit; `ru: 45` is the height it runs beside. Which side of the rack is a lab placement to say (docs/vertical-cable-managers-design.md).

rear.note: drawing - the rear as the front: the part is "front and rear" (WMPVHC45E against the front-only WMPVHCF45E), the same backbone, fingers and two covers.

right.note: estimated - the left view turned round.

shell.note: drawing - TWO HOLLOW CHANNELS BACK TO BACK, NOT A BOX. The body is a sheet body (docs/cable-managers-design.md section 4) and its six views are elevations. The solid is what its parts build: on each face the backbone as a well 166.1 deep with two columns of 45 fingers and two covers in it; both floors open at the eight oval holes.

thickness.note: estimated - no Panduit document states a wall gauge for the ABS moulding. 2.5 is a moulded wall of this size; the parts carry their own thicknesses.

top.note: estimated - the plan, rear at y=0: the rear fingers, the backbone and the front fingers, built from the plan view of the drawing and the finger lengths.

weight.note: drawing - 10.43 kg [23.0 lb], the weight table of the WMPVHC45E customer drawing.
